findings.title: Conditional gates accept entirely self-authored prerequisite and execution evidence
findings.evidence: A forged one-row SQLite database, arbitrary bundle hash and raw result with zero cases run produced a passing human_onboarding_verified decision.
findings.required_fix: Derive candidate and bundle identity independently, verify an append-only state chain, parse exact per-case results, enforce freshness and anti-replay, and reject caller-selected authority.

findings.title: Governance closes identifiers but not decisive financial and causal semantics
findings.evidence: PIT acceptance inversion, same-bar lookahead and corrupted split accounting all retained a PASS verdict.
findings.required_fix: Replace freeze-critical free text with canonical executable structures or exact semantic invariants and add value-preserving-ID mutation tests.

findings.title: Final independent-review closure can attest success without machine-checked attack evidence
findings.evidence: The final review schema binds summary metadata but does not validate commands, attacks, findings consistency or raw attack results.
findings.required_fix: Enforce a strict final-review schema, bind each attack to mutation and raw-result hashes, validate counts and replay required attacks before closure.

findings.title: Conditional evidence permits unbounded extra case claims
findings.evidence: required_cases is checked as a subset of evidence cases rather than exact equality.
findings.required_fix: Require exact case-set equality and one parsed result per case.

what_would_falsify_pass: Any semantics-changing mutation passes while identifiers remain intact.
Any caller-authored prerequisite or evidence can obtain a conditional verdict.
A final passing review can omit independently replayable attacks.
The resolved commit or tree differs from the reviewed identities.
A closure or bundle cannot be proven to descend non-circularly from the exact reviewed candidate.
limitations: The reviewer could not directly resolve github.com from its sandbox; the main agent separately completed direct remote and fresh-clone verification.
The existing governance suite passed before the independent attacks, but did not detect the four reported escapes.
No closure baseline or bundle was created because the verdict was blocked.
Project write access was not used; mutations existed only in isolated temporary copies.
